# ELITE DENTAL — MONTH 1 IMPLEMENTATION PLAN

## 1. Status and authority

This document records the founder-confirmed scope taken on for the first month of work with the only current client in this contour.

The commercial package is:

> **Setup Базовый + Усиление репутации — $1,900, разовый платёж.**

This file governs the first-month delivery checklist. It does not authorise public ELITE DENTAL launch claims, runtime creation, DNS changes or production replacement.

## 2. First-month objective

Prepare the clinic for systematic patient acquisition and begin reducing the competitive reputation gap across maps, while improving the patient journey, sales handling, internal referrals and content foundation.

The work must follow the path:

```text
maps → trust → service page → WhatsApp → consultation
```

## 3. Confirmed scope

### 3.1 Audit and analytics

- Audit Google Maps, Yandex Maps and 2GIS presence.
- Audit the current website.
- Audit Instagram.
- Audit WhatsApp and the handling of incoming enquiries.
- Analyse the current application and patient-contact flow.
- Compare the clinic in detail with 10–15 competitors in Bishkek for:
  - implantology;
  - veneers;
  - orthodontics.
- Prepare baseline source analytics.
- Prepare the first-month launch plan.

### 3.2 Maps packaging

- Fully package and improve the Google Maps profile.
- Fully package and improve the Yandex Maps profile.
- Fully package and improve the 2GIS profile.
- Check the consistency and completeness of core business information.
- Improve the clinic's visual and informational presentation on map surfaces.

### 3.3 Reputation system

- Build a white system for obtaining feedback from real patients.
- Configure the feedback flow around priority services, including:
  - veneers;
  - implantology;
  - orthodontics in Bishkek.
- Create QR mechanics for requesting feedback.
- Prepare practical instructions for administrators.
- Set up a process for responding to reviews.
- Start gradual reduction of the competitive review gap.
- Monitor:
  - published reviews;
  - rating dynamics;
  - map positions;
  - quality and themes of feedback;
  - compliance with platform rules.

### 3.4 Patient journey

- Design and document the path:

```text
maps → trust → service page → WhatsApp → consultation
```

- Identify gaps that reduce conversion between these stages.
- Define the minimum changes required for a coherent patient journey.

### 3.5 High-value service offers

- Prepare offers for three high-value treatment directions.
- The exact final wording and service composition must be approved against clinic capacity and current clinical priorities.

### 3.6 Sales scripts and follow-up

- Prepare scripts for handling price objections.
- Prepare scripts for handling patient fears and uncertainty.
- Prepare repeat-contact scripts.
- Prepare scripts and mechanics for returning lost or inactive enquiries.

### 3.7 Blog foundation

- Create the blog section.
- Create the article-list page.
- Create the article-page design/template.
- Prepare the initial article topics.
- Produce the agreed base article set.
- Publish the articles.
- Prepare the result for handover to Atabek.

### 3.8 Internal marketing and doctor cross-sales

Work separately with first-contact doctors, especially therapists and hygienists, whose patients initially come for basic treatment or professional hygiene.

- Introduce a clear internal referral system.
- Prepare speech markers that help doctors identify hidden functional and aesthetic needs.
- Train or brief doctors to explain relevant problems correctly and ethically.
- Create a handoff process from first-contact doctors to high-value directions, including:
  - veneers;
  - implantology;
  - orthodontics.
- The objective is to increase value from the clinic's existing patient flow without relying only on additional advertising spend.

## 4. Reputation baseline captured in the approved offer

The approved offer used the following point-in-time comparison examples:

### 2GIS

- Metadent: 438 reviews.
- Expert Dental: 130 reviews.

### Yandex Maps

- Kronis: 52 reviews.
- Expert Dental: 2 reviews.

### Google Maps

- Kronis: 122 reviews, rating 5.0.
- Expert Dental: 34 reviews, rating 4.8.

A separate summary block in the approved offer described the combined competitive gap as approximately 600 reviews and used the figures 2GIS 418, Google Maps 119 and Yandex Maps 63. Because these snapshots differ, they must be treated as point-in-time presentation figures and reverified before future public or contractual reuse.

## 5. Non-guarantees and compliance boundaries

- No guaranteed number of published reviews.
- No guaranteed rating increase.
- No guaranteed map-position increase.
- No guaranteed moderation or publication outcome.
- No fake reviews, purchased reviews, rating manipulation or platform-rule circumvention.
- Results depend on patient activity, clinic execution, platform moderation and existing baseline conditions.

The service is based on profile management, monitoring, responses, analytics, feedback collection from real patients and gradual improvement of the clinic's reputation profile.

## 7. Definition of done for Month 1

Month 1 is complete when:

- the audit and competitor comparison are delivered;
- the three map profiles are packaged to the agreed scope;
- the compliant reputation and QR workflow is documented and launched;
- administrator instructions are delivered;
- the patient journey is documented with required fixes;
- high-value offers and sales/follow-up scripts are delivered;
- the blog foundation and agreed base content are published;
- the doctor cross-sales system and speech markers are delivered;
- baseline and progress reporting is prepared;
- the completed work is handed over to Atabek.
